name: veqtor-workspace-pilot
description: Ask your AI assistant to read, edit and save your local documents.
long_description: For Macs with Apple Silicon (M1 or newer). Point to a saved Word file and describe what you want changed. Ask for tracked changes, comments or a clean copy. Include other documents for context. Veqtor edits a protected working copy and saves to the original file after checking for saved-file conflicts, or to a new file. Save your Word changes before starting. Veqtor runs locally; content read by your assistant is processed by your AI service.

author.title: Tracked-change author
author.description: The name written into new tracked changes and comments.

tools.name: workspace_info
tools.description: Show the author, runtime limits and the short editing recipe.

tools.name: document_task
tools.description: Snapshot a file, save in place or under a new name, or inspect an interrupted save.

tools.name: run_python
tools.description: Run Python or continue its stored output. Scratch work/ is writable even without an editing task; source files are read-only.

tools.name: check_docx
tools.description: Optional DOCX diagnostics: observations, read errors, warnings and unchecked areas.
